headline: United States GP: Sunday race day at COTA as Antonelli starts on pole
whyCareReason: Antonelli captured pole position (1:34.035) ahead of Verstappen and can seal his world title today.
teaser: Sunday race at COTA (15:00 local). Antonelli on pole; Verstappen P2, Hadjar P3, Leclerc P4. Antonelli leads by 102.
story: The 2026 United States Grand Prix reaches its climax on Sunday, 25 October, at the Circuit of the Americas in Austin, Texas. Mercedes sensation Kimi Antonelli snatched pole position in Saturday's qualifying shootout with a scintillating lap of 1:34.035, outpacing Red Bull's Max Verstappen by 0.179 seconds. Isack Hadjar qualified third ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton, while Antonelli's title rival George Russell starts down in sixth. Antonelli leads the drivers' championship by 102 points (340 to 238) and enters Sunday's 56-lap Grand Prix with his first mathematical opportunity to clinch the World Championship.
stakes: The world championship could be decided today in Texas if Antonelli converts pole position into victory.
rivalryAngle: Verstappen lines up alongside Antonelli on the front row with Ferrari's Leclerc lurking in fourth.
funFacts: Kimi Antonelli captured pole position with a 1:34.035 lap at COTA.
Max Verstappen starts alongside on the front row (+0.179s); Hadjar P3, Leclerc P4.
Antonelli defends a 102-point lead over George Russell (340 to 238) into Sunday's 56-lap race.
